Blocks phase 4 of docs/MIGRATION_PLAN.md. Full evidence: docs/READINESS_AUDIT.md §2.2.

## The defect

The importer and its verifier disagree about which PhotoPrism album types belong in the
catalogue:

- internal/ppimport/ppimport.go:89 - DefaultAlbumTypes = {album, folder, moment, state}.
  "month" is excluded ON PURPOSE: it is one auto-generated album per calendar month, 560 of
  them on the production library, already covered by Kukatko's timeline.
- internal/importverify/importverify.go:145 - defaults to photoprism.AlbumTypes, i.e. all
  FIVE types including month.

So the completeness report lists ~560 monthly albums as missing forever. Observed today:
`structure.albums.source_count: 758`, `missing_count: 751`, against a catalogue of 8.

## Why it matters

MIGRATION_PLAN.md phase 4 requires resolving "every listed missing item ... until the report
is clean". With this mismatch that is unachievable by construction, and genuinely missing
albums are buried under ~560 rows of expected noise — which defeats the purpose of the check
right at the point of no return.

## Fix direction

Either default the verifier to the importer's DefaultAlbumTypes, or keep walking all five
types but classify the intentionally-skipped ones separately (e.g. a `skipped_by_design`
bucket) so they never appear as `missing`. Prefer whichever keeps a single source of truth
for the type list rather than duplicating the constant in two packages.

## Verification (mandatory)

- A test asserting that albums of an intentionally-skipped type are NOT reported missing,
  while a genuinely absent album of an imported type IS.
- `make check` green.
- Note in docs/MIGRATION_PLAN.md phase 4 what a clean report now means.
